hypothesis: Observed black sky and grain in the Low DX12 rain sample may be related to quality-dependent rendering, not PNG corruption. This is an exploratory image-quality comparison, not model evaluation.
protocol: Fresh owned server; unchanged single-camera Phase 0 gates first, then collect_dataset probe --probe-scene 2 (five bundles, 24 sensors, six NPCs). Same frozen scene/rig/seed/weather. No TDR or global driver modification.
decision: Keep Low pilot integrity pass distinct from visual suitability. Record failures, manually inspect candidate RGB, report GPU resource limits without presuming Epic fits 8GB. Do not retune model/test accuracy on this diagnostic.
